sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Page shell and app mount point
sections.what: Sets the page language and title, provides the empty root container, and loads the module script that starts the viewer.
sections.why: This is the standard shape for a Vite-built app. The title states that the viewer only displays results.
sections.watch_out: The root container id must match the id the app looks up at startup, or the page stays empty.

summary: The page shell that loads the read-only run viewer.
purpose: Provides the empty container and the script entry point that the viewer app draws into.
why: Standard structure for a browser app built with Vite. The title says the viewer is read-only.
how: 1. The browser loads the page. 2. It finds an empty container named root. 3. It loads the main TypeScript entry file as a module, which then fills the page.
inputs: The browser, and the entry script at src/main.tsx.
outputs: A web page titled Workflow Modernization run viewer (read-only).
risks: If the entry script path is wrong, the page is blank and this file shows no error. All behaviour lives in the script, not here.
debug: For a blank page, check the browser console, confirm src/main.tsx exists, and confirm the container id matches what the app looks up.
